# P00 — Runnable project and build ledger

Status: **complete**. Executed October 24, 2026, Asia/Manila. Scope: `build-prompts/00-foundation.md`, following `build-prompts/BUILD-CONTRACT.md`.

## Delivered behavior

- React/TypeScript/Vite app at `/` with an honest unconfigured setup page. No fake metrics, success actions, login or domain data.
- React Router not-found route with return link and route error boundary with a generic recoverable page. Internal render diagnostics are not displayed.
- Explicit public-environment parser: project origin (HTTPS or local loopback HTTP), modern publishable key, missing/invalid safe messages. No entire environment object is copied into application code.
- Production build guard rejects partial/invalid public settings before generating new build output, including a misplaced secret-key value. Empty/empty builds the setup page. Publishable settings do not prove connectivity/authorization.
- Pinned package versions, one pnpm lockfile, working development/build/quality scripts, ignored secrets/dependency/build files, root README and reusable contracts/state protocol.
- Live local preview was started and browser-panel opening requested. Desktop/mobile screenshots captured independently. User preference to keep a preview visible is persisted in state, README and contracts.

## Environment and dependency decisions

Node 24.22.1 and pnpm 11.25.0 were available in the Codex bundled runtime. npm was not on PATH, so the documented package-script commands use pnpm. There was no previous app/lockfile. Initial `pnpm install` populated 189 packages into the empty project dependency directory; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then confirmed the lockfile.

Direct versions: React/React DOM 19.3.1, React Router 8.5.0, Vite 8.3.5, React plugin 6.1.2, TypeScript 6.0.3, Vitest 5.0.5, ESLint 10.13.0, TypeScript ESLint 8.72.0; full pins in package.json. TypeScript 7 was available but excluded by TypeScript ESLint's peer range, so 6.0.3 was deliberately selected. Packages/peer ranges were checked through `pnpm view` before install. No runtime/manager upgrade was performed.

Browser smoke used the bundled Node Playwright library with a clean, headless installed Edge context. Python Playwright was unavailable and default Playwright Chromium's executable was absent; no browser was downloaded or package added to work around that. Installed Edge ran successfully. This is a one-off smoke check, not a committed `test:e2e` suite or accessibility certification.

### Test coverage

Configuration: both settings missing; valid hosted HTTPS/local IPv4/localhost/IPv6 origins; malformed/remote HTTP/embedded credentials/path/query rejection; secret/legacy/incomplete key rejection without echoing values. Route rendering: missing config mounts; syntactically configured page renders no supplied URL/key or connected claim; unknown route recovery; thrown render error displays generic recovery without internal diagnostic.
